verdict.rationale: Stark Bank documents a RESTful, JSON-only API with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, SDKs in many languages, and a free sandbox. Agent-friendly docs are confirmed live by probes (llms.txt and a markdown API reference). However, the evidence mostly covers payment-initiation resources and never shows read endpoints for balances, the transaction ledger, pending activity, or statements and documents, and no MCP server is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented read access to account balances, transaction history, pending items and statements/documents; an official MCP surface; independent hands-on corroboration of agent read workflows.
